note: Owned by the category manager (cm-history); strands in subarea (population-economy, maps-borders, events-data), owned by cm-history-<strand>. demand: 1 low, 3 high, and EVERY demand value is the drafter's estimate (demandEstimate: true), not learner data: cm-history confirms or changes them at the first cycle planning. level: intro | core | stretch. dataOpened: true only where the drafter actually read the file's contents from this host on 2026-10-14 (fetching alone does not count). data: where the concept's numbers can be opened from this host (pinned = in company/domains/briefs/checks/history-data.mjs; opened, not pinned = read on 2026-10-14 but not yet pinned or checked; reachable, not opened = fetched but not read; not found yet = no openable dataset, so no brief until one is found). boundary: a neighbour category owns part of the idea (charter, Boundaries). sensitive: the class that sends a brief through the sensitive-topics route (charter; W-626). brief: the ranked brief that teaches it. Drafted 2026-10-14 by chief-of-staff-ceo-office (Leonie) at the founder's request (company/decisions/2026-10-14-history-category.md). Sized 2026-10-14 for about 100 lessons (company/decisions/2026-10-14-founder-history-100.md). reviewRoute (W-889, cm-history, 2026-10-15): "sensitive" for every concept with a sensitive class, "standard" otherwise. A sensitive concept's brief carries "Review route: sensitive (<class>)" and gets a cultural-reviewer review twice (company/reviews/<slug>/<date>-culture-en-brief.md before build, <date>-culture-en.md before publish) after a research-lead provenance note (company/decisions/2026-10-15-founder-sensitive-route-and-history-tranches.md; checklist company/international/sensitive-topics-checklist.md). The reviewer may add a class, never remove one; downgrading needs a head-of-product record. Standard concepts with "data": "not found yet" are re-tested against the checklist when their data is found.
